A restart/config migration can therefore restore the wrong provider/voice, or a stale Qwen pause/final can interfere with the next speech turn, without the Companion product gate noticing.

Latest upstream main still equals c3fc33ff0d32e4a79fd905d1add22d45725071f5; no newer implementation is needed.
Native VoiceConfig normalization and Qwen ASR worker remain the only runtime authorities. Reuse their existing tests on the patched product worktree.
No external component owns N.E.K.O voice-config normalization or Qwen ASR fallback turn fencing.
No alternate voice/session library is justified for a regression-wiring gap.
Only extend existing cloud/local Companion regression lists with native tests; repeat one short stale-turn case in micro-soak.

protected_product_risks: legacy/structured voice selection restores a different provider or clone after restart
same-id clone and configured preset resolve to the wrong authority
